subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content be exposed to trusted pre-auth hooks, and if so must sender grouping use the existing canonical `accessGroups` contract rather than channel-local fixed groups?
rationale: The repository already has a shared cross-channel group contract, while exposing denied-message content and implicitly activating trusted hooks are product and privacy choices that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Proceed with canonical groups
options.body: Keep pre-auth observation after explicit security acceptance, but replace grouped `{ number, group }` entries with canonical `accessGroups` membership and shared matched-group metadata.

options.title: Narrow pre-auth metadata
options.body: Allow a pre-auth event carrying only minimal redacted identity and denial metadata, without raw message content or automatic trusted-hook activation.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or park the PR if maintainers do not want a new pre-admission observation boundary in core.

recommendation.title: Proceed with canonical groups
recommendation.body: Keep pre-auth observation after explicit security acceptance, but replace grouped `{ number, group }` entries with canonical `accessGroups` membership and shared matched-group metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work spans the shared ingress, allowlist, command, and plugin SDK boundaries needed to decide the permanent contract.
